why.d: Born and raised in Mostar. The stories come from the city itself, not from a script.
Tours are led by a licensed tour guide with years of experience in Mostar and Herzegovina.
Short or long, slow or busy. The walk adjusts to your group, your time and your energy.
You talk directly to your guide before the tour, from the first message to the meeting point.
Add a coffee stop, a museum or a day outside the city. Routes are planned around what you want to see.

about.short: Mostarly Guide is based in Mostar and led by Mirna, a licensed local guide born and raised in Mostar.
paragraphs: I was born and raised in Mostar and grew up around tourism. I started working with visitors while I was still young, and guiding became my profession.
Mostar is my home. I know its complicated history as well as its everyday life: where people meet, what they eat, how the city changed and how it lives today.
I want my guests to understand more than the familiar view of the Old Bridge. That is why every tour is personal, at your pace, with time for your questions.

faq.a: Most standard city walks meet at the parking area next to the Hamam in the Old Town. The exact location is shared in your confirmation message. Some tours start at the parking area next to the Franciscan Church or at your accommodation, as stated on each tour page.

faq.q: Can the tour start at my hotel?
faq.a: Possible by prior arrangement. Tell us where you are staying and we will confirm the location and any additional cost.
Each tour page states whether the tour runs privately, as a shared group or in either format. If you are not sure, ask in your enquiry.
faq.note: Confirm private/shared format for each product.

faq.a: Only when the tour page says so. Extra tickets are listed separately with their current price, and you can tick the ones you want in the enquiry form.

The Old Town has uneven cobblestones, steps and slopes, so the standard walking routes are not wheelchair accessible. Please tell us about any individual needs before we confirm, and we will look at what is possible.
Tell us the ages of the children in your group. We confirm suitability and any age limits for each tour or activity before booking.

Comfortable walking shoes: the cobblestones are smooth and can be slippery. For visits to mosques and other religious sites, wear modest clothing that covers shoulders and knees, and follow the rules of each site.
If the weather makes a tour uncomfortable or unsafe, we will suggest adjusting the route, changing the time or rescheduling.
Payment details are confirmed personally together with your booking. No online payment is needed to send an enquiry.
